summary: Audited every California-specific assumption in backend/ and SPEC.md that blocks lower-48 coverage and designed the generalization (docs/redesign/audit-3/backend.md, revised after an independent review). NIFC WFIGS works as the national list: 1,178 lower-48 wildfires >= 300 ac in 2026, 861 in 2025, 241 active now (all listed per round-2 decision 1). POOState decides listing (point-in-polygon missed 3 real fires). California merge measured with the revised rule (complex names, lagged starts, all CAL FIRE sizes): 2025 WFIGS-CA >= 300 ac -> 69 same fire, 8 complex members, 2 gaps (Alpaugh; Big Cliff likely inside the Orleans Complex); today 64 of 70 active WFIGS-CA fires are not on CAL FIRE's lists. Correction: Timber is on CAL FIRE's 2026 list (IsActive false at 97 %), not missing. Eleven BLOCKERs: CAL FIRE-only catalog; FIRMS cut to the CA box; NWS area=CA; UTM 10/11; Pacific time in bundles; LANDFIRE LF2025 NoData outside SW/NW; perimeters US-CA; ids tied to calfire_uid; CAL FIRE named as issuer in bundle and forecast text; official lookups 404 for non-CAL FIRE fires; NWS zone placement that would show other states' alerts once alerts are national; plus the CA fuel-moisture table (validation G5). Open-Meteo counts weighted calls (a live weather refresh is ~22 calls). 25 recommended changes (14 P0) and 2 open user questions (Q-A California active status, Q-B California complexes); Q1-Q5 are answered by round 2.

Counts: 2026 WF >= 300 ac lower 48 = 1,178 (CA 69); 2025 = 861 (CA 79); active (Current, WF, lower 48, % < 100 or null) = 241, > 10 ac = 63, > 100 ac = 44, >= 300 ac = 34, unknown size = 45; Aug 1 2026 open estimate 180 (>= 10 ac) / 68 (>= 300 ac); perimeters for 822/1,178 (SACC 48 %, Southeast 30 %).

known_issues: Big Cliff (USFS, 973 ac, 2025) is probably counted inside CAL FIRE's Orleans Complex but WFIGS does not mark it as a member; R1's rule would list it separately (one known double listing).

Open-Meteo does not say whether ensemble members add to the weighted cost; the R13 budget should be checked against 429 answers in practice. The cloud egress IP is shared, so the daily cap can be reached by others.
The NWCG agency code -> plain name table for R10 must be checked against NWCG's code list (UnitIDx); its terms were not verified.
Off-reservation trust lands of the Navajo Nation and Hopi (TIGERweb AIANNHA layer 3) are left out of the time-zone file; small areas.
LF2025 remaining GeoAreas are scheduled for November 2026 by landfire.gov; the date may move.
FIRMS national archive parquet size not measured (no 46 MB download in an audit); estimate up to ~10-15x the CA file.
The audit is 400 lines, over the 150-250 guide, because the revision adds measured evidence and three BLOCKERs.
